method: Direct complete original image inspection via view_image detail=original. Initial coordinator inspection preceded arm report; final contact assessment also considered that report. Not a blinded review.

observations.evidence: Floodwater, gothic church arches, a cracked transparent reliquary containing a dark root and a luminous root path to a bronze bell are co-visible.
Short dark bob, wispy fringe, broad brown eyes and soft pink lips resemble the supplied visible appearance. This is not identity verification.

Stabilizing neck contact is visible. The turning fingers are beside the clamp screw; actual thumb/index contact with the exposed screw wings is not clear enough to pass the exact pre-render contact requirement.

Root is visible inside the crystal and along an exposed luminous route toward the bell. Its far end enters the lower clapper area; a complete coil around the actual heavy clapper cannot be established from the visible pixels.
Small brass and crystal highlights remain separated, with legible face and material surfaces.
A narrow dark lip gap is visible; jaw opening is small and no teeth are visible.
One boot and dry stone support are clear; the second sole and its support contact are hidden by the dress and composition.
observations.scope: supplemental frozen-prompt detail; not an additional managed hard gate

limits: No new module source was selected, so atmospheric success is not proof of new data use.
Ringing, movement over time, repair success and past care are not proved.
whole_case_basis: Pre-render crystal_root_bell_route and exact repair finger-to-wing contact are incomplete. Supplemental boot detail is not an additional managed hard gate.
